name: Admin Accounting Pocket Ledger
description: Superuser manages the ProjectApp pocket ledger at /panel/accounting/pocket: balance card from list meta, running-balance column (default view newest-first). The pocket is the money entry point: creating a movement also creates its linked income (IN) or expense (OUT). A new movement opens on Egreso, the common case, with every direction-dependent field already in its egreso variant; editing keeps the direction the record has. For IN the Contabilidad segmented is company-only; for OUT the selector is relabeled 'Atribuir a' (Empresa/Gustavo/Carlos) because pocket money is company money: every OUT mirrors a company-ledger expense that counts against liquid utility — Empresa splits 50/50, a partner option registers a draw fully assigned to that partner (category personal). Linked movements open the edit modal with the direction locked and the attribution prefilled (derived from the split); edits mirror into the linked record and deletes cascade both ways (confirm warns about the cascade). Unlinked historical movements keep plain CRUD. Since Aug 2026 the filter panel exposes every field the movement form captures (the 'insumo' criterion): on top of Fecha, Tipo and Valor it carries 'Atribuir a' (multi: Empresa/Gustavo/Carlos, over the mirror-derived `linked_ledger`) and 'Vínculo' (Todos/Vinculados/Sin vincular, over `is_auto_managed` — the way to find movements that never got their mirror), while the free-text fields ride the search box, which now covers `notes` as well as `concept`. Both new cuts exist server-side too (a `q_filters` knob on the shared filter layer), so the CSV export and the MCP `list_pocket` return the same rows the table shows, and the export gained 'Atribución' + 'Vinculado' columns. Because the running balance is a chronological accumulation, it is computed AFTER filtering: with any filter active the column is relabeled 'Acumulado' and sums only the visible rows, the subtitle says so, and the balance card — which the server always computes over every movement — is labeled '(total, no refleja los filtros)' and gains a 'N movimientos filtrados · neto X' line. The saved-tab strip (ProposalFilterTabs, the PA-44 standard) ships six seeded cuts — Entradas, Salidas, Gustavo, Carlos, Empresa, Sin vincular (migration accounts/0050 backfills them for existing users) — each with its count in parentheses, the honest (0) included, computed in the browser via `countTabs` since the whole dataset is already in the store; what does not fit the strip collapses into the '+N' overflow menu. Under the panel responsive contract, widths below 640 px stop rendering an eight-column table and render one semantic card per movement instead: a leading 44×44 action opens the row menu (Detalle e historial, Ver nota when the movement has one, Editar, Eliminar), concept and signed value lead the card, and date, atomic type/link badges and Saldo después (or Acumulado filtrado) follow as labelled facts. Those cards preserve sorting without horizontal scroll or overlap; from 640 px the priority table returns with the same leading action, the independent balance column returns at landscape width, module and saved-filter strips become selectors below 1024 px, and the 1400 px shell ceiling keeps the ledger coherent on a 2560 px monitor.
